text:
rachel: Quick note from the sample-app run: users see mixed error shapes across SDKs. UX shows "Unauthorized" with no action, leading to confusion.
tom: We need a minimal, flat contract: type, status, code, message, retryable, retry_after_seconds, intent, hint. Keep it easy to map in JS/Go/Py.
anika: Intent values should be small set: "refresh_credentials", "backoff_and_retry", "adjust_batching", "contact_support", "noop". Frontend maps intent->CTA.
rachel: Server will standardize headers: Retry-After (sec|date) and x-rw-error-code. Clients must normalize Retry-After to seconds.
tom: Streaming note: some streams embed error objects inside 200 frames. Clients must inspect and convert to typed errors.
anika: Example JS throw we'd document:
throw new UnauthorizedError({message: 'token expired', status: 401, code: 'invalid_token', retryable: true, intent: 'refresh_credentials', hint: 'prompt user to re-authenticate'});
devbot: Task created: "Error contract + intent mapping" assigned to @anika, due in 5 days.
docs-bot: Will add RFC skeleton and test vector list (delta-second header, http-date header, body-embedded error, streaming-frame error, oauth revoked).
